title: Add the published R437 histogram and compare its coefficient with the selected kappa
body:
## Summary
- The profile `{1:380160, 2:400864, 3:22176, 4:26592, 5:29376, 6:17376, 7:26496, 34:64, 42:352}` has 903,456 children and rank mass 1,808,352.
- Across 32 replicas the schedule hosts `32 · 3933 = 125856` helper occurrences, with width `32 · 888 = 28416` and physical width `28425`. Window 6 has `209 · 5 + 2 = 1047` occupied slots.
- The BIT coefficient `868314126713557740143/500000000000000000000000 = 0.001736628253427115480286` is greater than the selected kappa. Partial result. No new kappa and no selected-frontier change.
